messages.text: Build, typecheck, database tests, and API tests are now green, and the generated production bundle is compact apart from the framework runtime. The remaining acceptance boundary is the real browser: I’m installing the pinned Chromium runtime, then exercising both desktop and mobile flows with screenshots so I can inspect masonry crops, overlays, modal/detail layout, drawer/dock usability, checkout, analytics, and console cleanliness rather than inferring visual quality from compilation.
